(B) E_n ω_n
  n=1: E ω = 0 ≈ 0.00000, √n = 1.00000, ≤ : True
  n=2: E ω = 2/3 ≈ 0.66667, √n = 1.41421, ≤ : True

  n=5: E ω = 1265/1296 ≈ 0.97608, √n = 2.23607, ≤ : True
  n≤300 에서 E ω ≤ √n 과 E ω ≤ √(2/π)√((n+1)(n+2)/n) 위반: []
  n=6: √(2/π)√(7·8/6) = 2.4375775971438176  √6 = 2.449489742783178 ; 9·36-48·6-32 = 4
  n=5: √(2/π)√(6·7/5) = 2.3124891541124435  √5 = 2.23606797749979  (n=5 에서는 상계가 √n 을 넘으므로 직접 값이 필요)
  π > 25/8 : True ; 16(n+1)(n+2) ≤ 25n^2 ⇔ 9n^2-48n-32 ≥ 0 : True  n=5: False

(E) 적분 상계
  n=6: 2√((⌊n/2⌋+1)/(n-⌊n/2⌋)) = 2.309401 ≤ 2√((n+2)/n) = 2.309401: True
  n=7: 2√((⌊n/2⌋+1)/(n-⌊n/2⌋)) = 2.000000 ≤ 2√((n+2)/n) = 2.267787: True
  n=1000: 2√((⌊n/2⌋+1)/(n-⌊n/2⌋)) = 2.001999 ≤ 2√((n+2)/n) = 2.001999: True
  n=1001: 2√((⌊n/2⌋+1)/(n-⌊n/2⌋)) = 2.000000 ≤ 2√((n+2)/n) = 2.001997: True
  n=1000: (1/(n+1))Σ η = 1.95383242822696833171896989089 ≤ ∫_0^((⌊n/2⌋+1)/(n+1)) η = 2.00199900099875174737911830803: True

(G) 둘째 문장
  ⌈3n/4⌉ ≤ n-1 for 4≤n≤5000: True ; n=3: False
  ℓ* ≤ ⌈n/2⌉-1 ⇒ 2⌈3n/4⌉ ≥ n+ℓ* (n≤5000): True
